## Learning goals

Complete the exercises below using `fpp3`. Show plots and short written interpretations.

## Setup

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```


## 1. Chronological split

```{r}
train <- aus_production |> filter_index(. ~ "2010 Q4")
fit <- train |> model(snaive = SNAIVE(Beer), ets = ETS(Beer))
fc <- fit |> forecast(h = 8)
fc |> accuracy(aus_production)
```

## 2. Sensitivity

Change the origin (e.g. `"2009 Q4"`). Do rankings change?
